turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale, and a client call after that. Owen found out about a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class. Nobody called me. Why not?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.

Okay. Then take it off.

And tell me what you're basing it on, because I'm writing this down.
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
Okay. Withdrawing it is the first thing you've said that I'm writing down. You still haven't told me what you're basing a rewrite on, so what is the concern?
Here it is in writing, signed.

Hand it here. I'm reading it now, and I'm looking for three things: the zero removed, nothing placed on his file, and the rewrite private. You still haven't answered my question about the concern, Hale.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
I'm not finished, Hale. You still haven't told me what the concern is, and I'm not signing off on a rewrite when I don't know what it's for. What do you have?
You're not leaving until you answer me, Hale. What is the concern behind the rewrite? If you have nothing, I'm going to the principal's office next.
